case.goal: Diagnose where a parcel will go after the operator releases the pedal.
case.passage: A foot pedal moves a sorting gate toward the blue bin. A spring returns the gate toward the gray bin when pressure is removed. A parcel follows the gate position at the moment it reaches the fork. Releasing the pedal before the parcel reaches the fork changes its destination.

question: A learner claims: “Releasing the pedal stops the parcel from moving forward”. Which source excerpt best corrects their reasoning?
answer: Releasing the pedal before the parcel reaches the fork changes its destination
reason: A corrects the claim, but I can pick it without working out which bin the parcel reaches.
